column2: Actigraphy:  A Tool for Monitoring Sleep and Activity in an Isolated Environment (Aquarius)

column1:
Unstow and don actiwatch on non-dominant arm.

Record activity information (sleep/wake time, sleep activity, doff/don time, in-suit Doppler use) each day on Actiwatch Activity Log.

At the end of the mission, remove actiwatch and stow.
